additionalDescription: Space has always fascinated me, and Stellar was my way of sharing that passion. The challenge was taking complex astronomical data and presenting it in a way that feels magical rather than overwhelming. Every visualization is designed to inspire wonder while remaining scientifically accurate.
highlights: Created interactive 3D visualizations using Three.js and WebGL
Integrated NASA and ESA APIs for real-time space data
Built a custom physics engine for accurate orbital mechanics
Designed an educational mode with guided tours of the solar system
